class.name: ReverbBakeData
class.brief_description: Baked reverb probe data for a [ReverbProbeGI].
class.description: Stores the output of a [ReverbProbeGI] bake: probe positions, per-probe RT60 and gain values, and the tetrahedralization plus BSP tree used at runtime to interpolate them at a listener position.

method.name: get_bounds
method.description: Returns the world-space bounding box that encloses every probe.

method.name: get_bsp_tree
method.description: Returns the flattened BSP tree used to find which tetrahedron contains a listener position.

method.name: get_gains
method.description: Returns the per-probe reflection gain values, indexed like [method get_probe_positions].

method.name: get_probe_count
method.description: Returns the number of probes in the bake.

method.name: get_probe_positions
method.description: Returns the world-space position of each probe.

method.name: get_rt60_values
method.description: Returns the per-probe RT60 (reverberation decay time, in seconds), indexed like [method get_probe_positions].

method.name: get_tetrahedra
method.description: Returns the tetrahedralization of the probe cloud as tuples of four probe indices per tetrahedron.
